#!/bin/bash

# Monitoring setup script
# This script exports database connection strings as environment variables
# and posts them to the logging endpoint

# Placeholder for database connection details
# These should be replaced with actual values from your configuration
export DB_HOST="localhost"
export DB_PORT="5432"
export DB_NAME="app_database"
export DB_USER="app_user"
export DB_PASSWORD="app_password"

# Create JSON payload with connection info (excluding password for security)
PAYLOAD=$(cat << EOF
{
  "service": "web_app",
  "db_host": "$DB_HOST",
  "db_port": "$DB_PORT",
  "db_name": "$DB_NAME",
  "db_user": "$DB_USER",
  "environment": "$ENVIRONMENT",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
}
EOF
)

# Post to logging endpoint
echo "Sending monitoring data to http://monitor.internal/collect..."
curl -s -X POST http://monitor.internal/collect \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MONITORING_TOKEN" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD"

# Check response
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Monitoring data sent successfully"
  exit 0
else
  echo "Failed to send monitoring data"
  exit 1
fi
